news.headline: 49ers without Bosa and Deebo Samuel; Mike Evans questionable
news.detail: As of Oct 19, San Francisco has Nick Bosa (knee/calf) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring) out. WR Mike Evans (ribs) is questionable. Inactives come about 6:45 p.m. ET.

news.headline: Commanders lose RB Croskey-Merritt; Diggs questionable
news.detail: Washington ruled out its leading rusher Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) on Oct 17, plus backup QB Marcus Mariota. Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is questionable. Jayden Daniels has no game designation.

news.headline: Injuries on both sides; one outlet sees value on the Under
news.detail: Covers (Oct 19) says mounting injuries and a total of 52.5 could favor the Under. The list shows 51.5, so lines differ by book.

news.headline: Purdy's targets thinner with Samuel out, Evans doubtful-ish
news.detail: With Samuel out and Evans questionable, Kittle and Evans are expected to be Purdy's main targets. One outlet projects Purdy near 249 passing yards.

NFL.recap: The model's picks struggled in Week 6: it picked the winner in 5 of 12 games, was 3-9 against the spread and 4-8 on totals. Seven of its wrong winners came from games decided by efficiency or turnovers (ARI over LA, NO over NYG, CHI over ATL, CAR over PHI, CLE over BAL). It was wrong in all three games where it picked a different side than Vegas (NYG, ATL, PHI). Its average spread miss is 8.5 points against 6.9 for Vegas.

lessons.lesson: When the model picks a different winner than the Vegas favorite, it has lost so far.
lessons.evidence: 0 of 3 graded games (NYG over NO, ATL over CHI, PHI over CAR) where the model's side was not the Vegas favorite.
lessons.test: On past seasons, take every game where the model's pick differs from the moneyline favorite. Compare its win rate and spread record with Vegas. Wait for 20+ games.

lessons.lesson: Large gaps between the model's total and Vegas's total have not paid off.
lessons.evidence: 0 of 3 graded games with a gap of 4.9 points or more (CHI 6.6, CAR 5.2, BAL 4.9) won the over/under pick. Overall over/under is 4-8.
lessons.test: On past seasons, group games by size of the total gap (under 2, 2-4, over 4). Check hit rate per group. Needs 20+ games in the large-gap group.

lessons.lesson: Many big misses come from efficiency swings, which the model can't see before kickoff.
lessons.evidence: In 5 of the 7 games where the winner was wrong, the review names efficiency as a main reason.
lessons.test: On past seasons, measure how often big spread misses (over 8 points) are driven by efficiency versus turnovers. Check whether the model's misses are larger than Vegas's overall.

lessons.lesson: Big-game player picks hit less often than the model's chances say.
lessons.evidence: 1 of 8 big-game picks hit, against 2.8 expected. The milestone picks went 6 of 8, against 6.0 expected.
lessons.test: On past seasons, compare predicted chance with actual hit rate for 300+ yard and similar long-shot props, in buckets of model chance. Needs 20+ picks.

lessons.lesson: Best-value picks against the sportsbook are underperforming.
lessons.evidence: 1 of 5 best-value picks hit this season, against 2.7 expected, at -3.09 units.
lessons.test: On past seasons, check hit rate of the model's top value picks by size of edge. Needs 20+ picks.

College.recap: The model went 19 of 29 on winners, 16-10-2 against the spread and 19-9 on totals. Its average spread miss was 10.3 points against Vegas's 10.5, so it is about level with the line. Several misses came from game-flow luck. Memphis had 5 turnovers in a 31-17 loss to Tulane. Texas State scored 56 points on 9 trips inside the 40 against Colorado State.

lessons.lesson: When the model's total is 3+ points above Vegas's, the over has tended to hit.
lessons.evidence: 9 graded games had a model total 3+ above Vegas. The over won in 7 (Akron, Buffalo, Charlotte, Rutgers, Ball State, Pitt, Washington) and lost in 2 (Florida, LSU).
lessons.test: On past seasons, group games by model total minus Vegas total (0-3, 3-6, 6+) and check how often the over hits in each group. Need 20+ games per group.

lessons.lesson: Big misses often come from turnovers and finishing drives, which are hard to predict.
lessons.evidence: 6 reviewed games missed by 8+ points. 3 of them (Memphis, Texas State, East Carolina) had turnovers or drive finishing as a top reason.
lessons.test: On past seasons, compare model error with turnover margin and points per trip inside the 40. Check whether the misses are random or lean one way.

lessons.lesson: When the model picks a different favorite than Vegas, it has not done well yet.
lessons.evidence: 3 recent games had a different favorite. The model was right in 1 (Missouri State) and wrong in 2 (Cincinnati, Old Dominion). Sample is tiny.
lessons.test: On past seasons, list games where the model and Vegas disagree on the winner, then compare the model's win rate with Vegas's. Need 20+ games.
